content.comment_body: Is there a way to retrieve previous datalog CSV files from the [product_name] through the network, apart from physically removing the MicroSD card to copy them? Using [product_name] Comfort only lets you access the current CSV file. Sometimes, historical data is needed, but it isn’t available in the current file due to network or power disruptions that cause the device to generate a new CSV. The affected units are spread out in various locations and accessing their SD cards directly is not practical. The [product_name] Access Tool also only logs a single unit and does not function during network disruptions.
No, unfortunately this isn't possible. With LSC, you can only read out the latest data log. To download older data logs from the SD card, you have to read the SD card directly on a PC.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are unable to remotely access historical CSV log files from [product_name] after network or power interruptions, as available tools only provide the most recent log from one device at a time. This limitation poses significant difficulties for installations where physical access to devices is limited.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to be able to download all, including previous, data log files from several devices across the network—even when new files are created after interruptions.
pain_keywords: lack of remote historical log access
